Allium now ships a single **1.12.2–26.3** JAR for Bukkit, Spigot, Paper, Purpur, and Folia alongside brand-new standalone alpha JARs for **Fabric (1.14–26.3)** and **NeoForge (1.20.2–26.3)**.

## Unified Bukkit, Spigot, Paper, Purpur & Folia (1.12.2–26.3)

One `Allium-Paper-1.0.2.jar` runs everywhere from Minecraft **1.12.2** to **26.3**: servers on **1.20–26.3** (Java 17+) load the full modern runtime, while servers on **1.12.2–1.19.4** (Java 8+) automatically boot the embedded compatibility runtime.

- **Full legacy 1.12.2–1.19.4 feature parity**: ported CreativeManager (`/creativemanager`), EssentialsX dry-run/apply importer (`/allium import essentials`), public chat formatting, channels, and opt-in `chat.filter` rules, `hide.yml` command hider (`/allium hide`), Powertools, Vouchers, and Handcuffs (`/unrestrain`), `/delmsg` chat deletion & re-sync, server taxes (`/tax`), alt detection (`/altexempt`), `/editnick` styling GUI, money cheques (`/cheque`), XP bottles (`/xpbottle`), `/tppet` and `/tpmob` with particle/glow highlights, `/autorestart` & `/voterestart`, `/redeem`, `/recipe`, `/editsign`, `/firework`, `/potion`, `/unlimited`, text pages & timed broadcasts, `/clearchat`, `/tpoffline`, `/spectate`, timed flight & slow-fall landing protection, persistent `/rtoggle` and `/payconfirmtoggle`, fuzzy teleport name matching, and command usage cards.
- **Fixes & polish**: fixed DiscordSRV webhook chat relay, blocked SpawnerChanger on crafted/upgradable spawners, fixed WorldEdit double-slash command filtering in `hide.yml`, fixed Paper/Canvas plugin unwrapping, and added localized startup headers.

## New Fabric Alpha (1.14–26.3) & NeoForge Alpha (1.20.2–26.3)

`Allium-Fabric-1.0.2.jar` (`1.0.2+mc1.14-26.3-fabric`) and `Allium-NeoForge-1.0.2.jar` (`1.0.2+mc1.20.2-26.3-neoforge`) bring Allium's core dedicated-server essentials natively to modded servers in a single universal JAR per loader.

- **Unified `plugins/Allium/` directory**: keep the mod JAR in `mods/` while Allium extracts default `config.yml`, `lang/en_US.yml`, `lang/es_ES.yml`, `info.txt`, `rules.txt`, `motd.txt`, `custom.txt`, `broadcasts.txt`, and `worth.yml` into `plugins/Allium/` (reload anytime with `/allium reload`).
- **Travel & utilities**: `/sethome`, `/home`, `/delhome`, `/homes`, `/renamehome`, `/setwarp`, `/warp`, `/delwarp`, `/warps`, `/setspawn`, `/spawn`, `/tpa`, `/tpahere`, `/tpaccept`, `/tpdeny`, `/tpacancel`, `/tphere`, `/back`, `/tptoggle`, `/tpauto`, `/heal`, `/feed`, `/fly`, `/gmc`, `/gms`, `/gma`, `/gmsp`, `/day`, `/night`, `/sun`, `/rain`, `/storm`, `/clearinventory`, `/ping`, `/coords`, `/depth`, `/list`, and `/broadcast`.
- **Economy & cross-mod support**: `/bal`, `/pay`, `/paytoggle`, `/payconfirmtoggle`, `/eco`, `/baltop`, `/worth`, `/setworth`, and `/sell`. Automatically bridges to **EconomyCraft** when installed, and exposes `AlliumEconomyApi` for mods such as **GriefPrevention3D**.
- **Player info, mail & text pages**: `/mail`, `/seen`, `/whois`, `/playtime`, `/afk`, `/nick`, `/realname`, `/near`, `/info`, `/rules`, `/motd`, `/customtext`, `/inform`, and `/broadcasts`.
- **Moderation, chat channels & Discord relay**: `/mute`, `/unmute`, `/setjail`, `/deljail`, `/jails`, `/jail`, `/unjail`, `/jailedplayers`, `/warn`, `/warnings`, `/notes`, `/unnote`, `/freeze`, `/kickall`, `/vanish`, `/report`, `/helpop`, `/channel`, `/g`, `/l`, `/a` (staff chat), `/me`, `#staff`/`>global`/`?question` live chat routing, join/quit hooks, and async Discord webhook relay configured via `plugins/Allium/config.yml`.

## Downloads & installation

- **Bukkit / Spigot / Paper / Purpur / Folia (`1.0.2+mc1.12.2-26.3-paper`)**: place `Allium-Paper-1.0.2.jar` in `plugins/`. Optional official addons (`Addon-{Crops,Curios,Menus,Ores,PartyLocator,SpawnerCraft}-1.0.2.jar`) are attached as supplementary downloads for `plugins/Allium/addons/`.

Allium and all six official addons now support **Folia**. The new **Menus** addon adds configurable player and staff interfaces, and the core adds player settings commands, held-item editing tools, and more Essentials commands.

## Folia and storage

- Allium and its official addons use region- and entity-owned scheduling on Folia. Core travel uses Folia's asynchronous teleport API.
- Allium supports SQLite, MySQL, and MariaDB. SQLite is the default. To use MySQL or MariaDB, set `database.type: MYSQL` and configure `database.mysql`. Each server should use its own economy schema. Changing the backend selects a separate data store. [Server compatibility and database setup](https://github.com/castledking/Allium#server-compatibility)

## New official addon — Menus

- Open `/settings` or select **Allium** in Minecraft's Escape menu. Menus offers native dialogs for compatible clients and inventory interfaces on Spigot or older clients.
- Browse homes and warps, request teleports, edit nicknames and held-item text, choose join and leave messages with `/jm` or `/qm`, and manage powertools in `/ptgui`. Staff can open the permission-aware `/punish` panel.
- `/shop` includes the SurvivalFun catalog with paged categories, formatted item tooltips, and per-item buy and sell prices. Configuration supports conditions, persistent player variables, and custom warp icons.
- Configure panels in `plugins/Menus/`. Menus moves data from `plugins/Allium/Menus/` on startup if the new folder is absent. Restart after Menus generates or updates its Escape menu datapack. [Menus configuration and commands](https://github.com/castledking/Allium/tree/master/addons/menus)

## New core commands

| Command | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `/toggles`, `/settings` | View player preferences. `/settings` opens Menus when it is enabled and otherwise shows clickable controls in chat. |
| `/toggle <tpa\|msg\|pay> [on\|off]` | Change who can send you teleport requests, private messages, or payments. |
| `/itemflag` (`/iflag`, `/if`, `/ie`) | Edit the held item's tooltip flags and attribute modifiers. |
| `/world`, `/xpbottle` | Travel between worlds and store experience in bottles. |
| `/pvp`, `/helpop`, `/editnick`, `/unnote` | Toggle PvP, contact staff, edit your nickname, or remove a staff note while retaining its audit history. |

Core also adds buy, sell, and player-owned stock trade signs, per-type teleport warmups, a configurable first-join onboarding flow, and broader EssentialsX import coverage for kits, worth, and back locations.

## Addon updates and installation

- **Curios** expands relic effects and card boosts, adds custom frame authoring, and lets players equip cards and relics by right-clicking with the item in hand. Relic tooltips show their effects.
- **Crops** keeps internal growth and pie models out of give commands. Its sellable produce and finished pies are available to shop integrations.
- The release includes `Allium-1.0.1.jar` and `Addon-{Crops,Curios,Menus,Ores,PartyLocator,SpawnerCraft}-1.0.1.jar`. Replace your core jar in `plugins/` and update installed addon jars in `plugins/Allium/addons/`. To install Menus from the server, run `/allium addon download menus` and restart. For a manual install, enable `addons.enabled.menus` in `plugins/Allium/config.yml`.

# Allium v1.0.0

**Wiki:** https://github.com/castledking/Allium/wiki

Allium v1.0.0 is a complete ground-up recode of Allium engineered for **Spigot, Paper, Purpur, and Folia (`1.20` – `26.x`, Java 17+)**, splitting specialized gameplay systems into five official addons managed by Allium's versioned Addon API (`1.6.0`).

---

## Release Assets & Installation

Place **`Allium-1.0.0.jar`** in `plugins/`, and place any desired addon jars inside **`plugins/Allium/addons/`**:

| Artifact | Install Path | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Allium-1.0.0.jar` | `plugins/` | Core essentials, economy, signs, chat, mail, moderation, ModGuard, tools, restore, hide, explosions, importers, and resource pack delivery. |
| `Addon-Crops-1.0.0.jar` | `plugins/Allium/addons/` | Custom crops, fertilizers, sprinklers, Kitchen baking & pies, and Jade overlays. |
| `Addon-Curios-1.0.0.jar` | `plugins/Allium/addons/` | Trading cards, 7-slot Relics equipment, textured menus, morphs, `/frame`, and chat hover frames. |
| `Addon-Ores-1.0.0.jar` | `plugins/Allium/addons/` | Deterministic CraftEngine custom ore generation, `/pregen`, and Jade ore overlays. |
| `Addon-PartyLocator-1.0.0.jar` | `plugins/Allium/addons/` | `/party` groups and vanilla `1.21.6+` locator bar integration. |
| `Addon-SpawnerCraft-1.0.0.jar` | `plugins/Allium/addons/` | 208+ signed mob head drops, Spawner Changers, and interactive multi-recipe slideshow guides. |

---

## Highlights

- **Platform-neutral core (`1.20` – `26.x`) & Folia-ready scheduling** — Built on a Java 17 Spigot baseline with reflective Paper Brigadier commands (`1.20.6+`), optional Java 21 item provider adapters (`Nexo`, `CraftEngine`, `Oraxen`), optional `GriefPrevention`/`GriefPrevention3D` protection hooks, and unified region-aware scheduling.
- **Official modular Addon API (`1.6.0`), auto-installer & pack merging** — Addons live cleanly in `plugins/Allium/addons/`, can be downloaded directly from GitHub Releases via `/allium addon download <addon>` or `addons.auto-download: true`, and can be toggled on/off without removing their jars via `/allium addon enable|disable <addon>` (`addons.enabled.*` in `config.yml`). Enabled addons share signed custom items and vanish/hide visibility checks, and automatically merge their bundled resource packs into Allium's standalone self-host server or `ResourcePackManager` (`rpm-export`).
- **Journaled SQLite / MySQL economy** — Atomic ledger with WAL `synchronous=FULL`, optional Vault provider, `/bal`, `/pay`, `/baltop`, `/eco`, `/paytoggle`, `/payconfirm`, transaction taxes with refund audit trails, signed physical bank cheques (`/cheque`), `/worth` & `/sell` multipliers, and cross-module reservations for paid signs, kits, and mail gifts. Full support for Geyser/Floodgate `.`-prefixed Bedrock usernames.
- **Complete non-shop Essentials signs parity + short prices** — All 22 interactive sign types (`color`, `balance`, `warp`, `kit`, `mail`, `heal`, `repair`, `disposal`, `info`, `workbench`, `anvil`, `cartography`, `grindstone`, `loom`, `smithing`, `gamemode`, `time`, `weather`, `randomteleport`/`rtp`, `free`, `enchant`, `spawnmob` including `wolf:tamed` owned by the clicking player). Prices `>= $1,000` format compactly (`$1K`, `$1.1K`, `$1.25K`, `$1.5M`) via `sign-short-prices: true`.
- **Full Essentials / EssentialsX importer (`/allium import essentials`)** — Read-only dry-run reports plus login-fenced, ledger-tracked apply importing balances, homes, warps, spawns (`spawn.yml`), logout locations, legacy & structured mail, nicknames, ignore lists, player preferences, jails (`jail.yml`/`jails.yml`), active mutes, jailed assignments, account names, and `enabledSigns` — plus automatic migration of legacy Essentials dark-blue (`§1[Type]`) world signs on apply, chunk load, and click.

# Allium v0.2.20a

**Wiki:** https://github.com/castledking/Allium/wiki

## Highlights

- **Deterministic CraftEngine custom ores & asynchronous pre-generation (`/pregen`)** — Native custom ore generation returns to Allium using CraftEngine block carriers instead of legacy Oraxen note blocks. Salt, Silver, and Galena ores generate in stone and deepslate variants with stable seeds, custom vein geometry, chunk height clamps, and lowland/mountain elevation limits. A new asynchronous runner under `/pregen` (and `/allium pregen`) pregenerates chunks with rate pacing (`chunks-per-tick`, `delay-ticks`) and safe pause, resume, and cancellation support.
- **Zero-scale Jade 26.3 ore HUD overlay** — Datapack block discovery in Jade 26.3 is supported via a zero-scale, packet-only item display entity that tracks the player's crosshair over custom ores within six blocks. It supplies the genuine CraftEngine item name, custom texture, and stack identity without creating world entities, adding chunk metadata, or interfering with existing Jade handshake handlers.
- **Interactive snapshot editor & manual copies in `/restore`** — Staff with `allium.restore.edit` can now interactively edit inventory restoration sessions directly in the GUI. Items can be freely moved between the snapshot panel and staff inventories, with support for all 36 storage slots, armor, offhand, and ender chests. Edits can be applied directly to a player or saved as a non-destructive `MANUAL` snapshot copy. A configurable 30-day snapshot retention policy and `/core purge restoresnapshots` command prevent database bloat.
- **Card level-up announcement debouncing** — Fast bursts of card experience (e.g. high-reward quest completions) that advance multiple levels at once no longer flood chat with sequential level-up alerts. `CardLevelAnnouncements` combines contiguous level gains across a 10-tick window into a single unified announcement without delaying XP application or stat boosts.
- **Quest difficulty multipliers and multi-plugin card XP bridges** — Quests (LMBishop) and ExcellentQuests integrations now support granular difficulty multipliers (`QuestXpRules`) mapped to quest IDs, categories, or stage suffixes. EcoJobs and LiteFish integrations are hardened: LiteFish catch events provide non-zero hook values to prevent EcoJobs counters from evaluating to zero, and duplicate XP payouts across custom and Bukkit catch events are eliminated. Damage attribution for card XP now traces projectile shooters and modern Paper `DamageSource` causes.
- **Player scale boost overhaul & automatic unmorph** — The player scale bonus boost now rolls cleanly between configurable `minimum` and `maximum` bounds (0.6x to 2.0x) based on slot strength, replacing flat addition. Unequipping or replacing an equipped card now automatically terminates active morph disguises if the new card cannot grant the form. Dropping cards with `Q` can also be toggled via `card-menu.allow-drop`.
- **Tablist rank preservation (`FarPlayerReAddPolicy`)** — When distant-player rendering plugins like ExtendedHorizons resend player tab entries beyond the tracking range, Allium strips redundant display name and list order actions from the packet. This keeps TAB's formatted prefixes, suffixes, and sorting intact.
- **CrowBar radar HUD alignment** — Radar dots sent to CrowBar clients now consult `PartyManager.isOnLocatorFor()`. CrowBar blips follow the exact same party visibility, staff locator overrides, and card-widened locator boost ranges as the vanilla locator bossbar instead of revealing players across the whole world.

# Allium v0.2.19a

**Wiki:** https://github.com/castledking/Allium/wiki

## Highlights

- **Trading cards get a full workshop redesign.** Right-click a card to open its card menu, then manage bonus boosts, merge eligible cards, or trade a card in through dedicated menus. The menus use the Nexo glyph titles and matching button artwork, with small-caps card text and a level bar that shifts color as the card approaches its next level.
- **Card progression is more predictable.** Signature boosts are fixed by tier rather than rolled: Simple starts with three, Ultimate with four, and Fabled with five. Bonus boosts remain tier-unlocked and are rolled separately. Crafted cards now receive their quality and signatures from the configured card tables. Removing a card also removes its stat boosts and restores the player's previous scale.
- **Merging and trading are safer.** A merge preserves the better quality, creates the next-tier card with that tier's fixed signatures, and consumes its inputs only after a valid result is available. Trade-in now pays the configured reward, including recovery for payouts that could not be delivered immediately.
- **Crop stages can render as CraftEngine blocks.** Crop definitions support block references and staged custom visuals, with a fallback renderer when CraftEngine is unavailable. CraftEngine items can also be resolved through the item integration layer.
- **Command visibility and compatibility are tightened.** Command suggestion filtering now follows the command tree and command paths, while API compatibility checks cover the supported Paper versions in CI. CraftEngine replaces the removed Oraxen compile-time item and smelting integrations.
- **Additional fixes and content.** This release adds the Bong item and listener, improves crop interactions and rendering, and updates nickname, morph, and item resolution behavior.

## Upgrade notes

- Back up existing card and trading-card configuration before upgrading; review the updated `tradingcards/config.yml` and `tradingcards/boosts.yml` for the revised tier, signature, and bonus-slot settings.
- CraftEngine is optional. Crop stages retain the configured fallback behavior when it is not installed.
